Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Avery planning proposal. Strict meetings: I intend to attend Job interview m015 full [0,1) and University class m007 full [13,14). For soft meetings, to avoid overlap penalties I suggest a non-overlapping chain maximizing broad coordination: art workshop m010 [1,2), volleyball m001 [2,3), friends hangout m002 [3,4), friends hangout m014 [4,6), study group m006 [6,7), swimming m009 [7,8), study group m004 [8,9), music jamming m016 [9,10), friends hangout m008 [10,13). I plan to skip m011 and m003 unless others strongly prefer those instead. If others can align with these slots, we can get overlap credit without self-conflicts.

Reese planning proposal. I must choose between conflicting strict meetings at [0,1): Doctor’s appointment m005 and Job interview m015. Since strict rewards require full attendance and we cannot overlap, my current preference is m015 [0,1) because Avery already plans that; if others strongly coordinate on m005 instead I can reconsider. For soft meetings, to avoid overlap penalties I propose a clean chain close to Avery’s: m010 art [1,2), m001 volleyball [2,3), m002 friends [3,4), m014 friends [4,6), m006 study [6,7), m012 music [7,8), m004 study [8,9), m016 music [9,10), then either m008 friends [10,12) or m013 art [10,12) depending on where others cluster. I currently plan to skip m011 swimming and m003 gym unless needed for coordination. If anyone prefers doctor m005 over interview m015, or has a strong preference between m008 vs m013 at 10-12, let me know. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley planning proposal. For strict meetings, [0,1) has a conflict between Doctor’s appointment m005 and Job interview m015; to coordinate with Avery/Reese I currently prefer m015 full [0,1) and will attend University class m007 full [13,14). For soft meetings I support a non-overlapping chain similar to Avery/Reese, adapted to my meetings: m010 art [1,2), m001 volleyball [2,3), m002 friends [3,4), m012 music [5,6), m006 study [6,7), m009 swimming [7,8), m004 study [8,9), m016 music [9,10). I would skip m011 swimming [1,5) to avoid conflicts with art/volleyball/friends, and likely skip m003 gym [8,11) because it conflicts with m004/m016. Main open question: should Riley-side participants cluster on m012 [5,6) then m006 [6,7) then m009 [7,8), or use a different 5-8 sequence? Also please confirm whether group is converging on m015 over m005 at [0,1). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor planning proposal. For my strict meetings, I can attend Doctor’s appointment m005 full [0,1) and University class m007 full [13,14). Note m015 is not my meeting, so I cannot help on that conflict; for shared coordination among my meetings I currently favor m005 [0,1) and m007 [13,14). For soft meetings, to avoid self-overlap I suggest this non-overlapping chain on my meetings: m010 art [1,2), m001 volleyball [2,3), m011 swimming [3,4) or skip, m014 friends [4,5), m012 music [5,6), m006 study [6,7), m009 swimming [7,8), m004 study [8,9), m016 music [9,10), then m008 friends [10,13) or m013 art [10,13) depending on where others cluster. Since many others are currently skipping m011 and m003, I’m also happy to skip those and align with the main chain: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m009 or m012 on [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13). Key issue from my side: at [0,1) I can only support m005, not m015; if Jordan/Riley/Reese want strict coordination with me, please consider whether any of you can switch to m005. Also please indicate preference for 10-13 between m008 friends vs m013 art.

Jordan planning proposal. For strict meetings, I currently prefer Job interview m015 full [0,1) rather than Doctor’s appointment m005, since Avery/Reese/Riley are already leaning to m015 and strict reward needs exact full attendance; I will also attend University class m007 full [13,14). For soft meetings, I support the emerging non-overlapping chain on my meetings: m010 art [1,2), m001 volleyball [2,3), m002 friends [3,4), m014 friends [4,6), then skip to m004 study [8,9), and likely m008 friends [10,13) rather than m013 art, to concentrate overlaps. I currently plan to skip m011 swimming and m003 gym to avoid conflicts with the chain. Open questions from my side: whether anyone wants to use any 6-8 slot I’m involved in (I only have m002/m014 ending by 7, then m004 at 7-11 and m003 at 8-11), and whether we should definitively cluster on m008 over m013 for 10-13.

Quinn planning proposal. For strict meetings, I support m015 Job interview full [0,1) and m007 University class full [13,14). For soft meetings, to avoid overlap penalties while matching the emerging chain, my current plan is: m010 art [1,2), m001 volleyball [2,3), m002 friends [3,4), m014 friends [4,6), m012 music [5,6), m009 swimming [6,7), m004 study [8,9), m016 music [9,10), m008 friends [10,13). I would skip m011 swimming, m006 study, m003 gym, and likely m013 art if we concentrate on m008. Main suggestion: converge on m015 over m005 for those eligible, and on m008 over m013 for 10-13.

Avery update: I support convergence on m015 [0,1) for those eligible and m007 [13,14) full. For soft meetings, I’m happy to lock the shared non-overlapping chain on my meetings as: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m009 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13). I will skip m011 and m003, and also skip whichever of m006/m009/m004/m016/m008 is not in that exact slot sequence outside their listed slot. This gives me zero self-overlap and should create broad pairwise overlap if others align. If anyone sees a better Avery-specific adjustment, let me know; otherwise I’ll likely commit this in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese update: I support locking the common plan as follows for my meetings to maximize overlap without self-conflict: strict m015 Job interview [0,1) full, and skip m005 Doctor’s appointment. Soft chain: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m012 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13). I will skip m011, m003, and m013 under this plan. Note I use m012 at [7,8) because unlike Avery/Jordan I am not in m009, and this keeps my schedule non-overlapping. If others can align especially on m015 and m008, that seems best from my side. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley update: I’m ready to converge on the shared plan. For strict meetings on my side I support m015 Job interview [0,1) full and m007 University class [13,14) full, skipping m005 due to the conflict. For soft meetings I plan the non-overlapping chain on my meetings as: m010 art [1,2), m001 volleyball [2,3), m002 friends [3,4), m012 music [5,6), m006 study [6,7), m009 swimming [7,8), m004 study [8,9), m016 music [9,10). I will skip m011 and m003. Note I am not in m008/m014, so my schedule naturally has a gap [4,5). This aligns with Avery/Reese/Quinn/Taylor where possible and keeps zero self-overlap. Unless anyone objects, I’ll likely commit exactly this in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor update: I can’t join m015, so for strict meetings I plan m005 Doctor’s appointment full [0,1) and m007 University class full [13,14). For soft meetings I’m happy to align with the shared chain on my meetings as: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), then at [7,8) I can do either m009 swimming or m012 music; after that m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), and m008 [10,13). I’ll skip m011, m003, and likely m013 if we concentrate on m008. Since several others are converging on m008 over m013, I support m008 [10,13). For [7,8), my slight preference is m009 to align with Avery/Riley, but I can switch to m012 if Reese/Quinn think that gives better overlap. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan update: I’m ready to lock my execution plan unless anyone objects. Strict: m015 Job interview [0,1) full, skip m005, and m007 University class [13,14) full. Soft on my meetings: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m004 [8,9), m008 [10,13). I will skip m011, m003, and m013. This keeps zero self-overlap and matches Quinn/Avery/Reese/Riley/Taylor on the main chain where possible, especially m015, m010, m001, m002, m014, m004, and m008.

Quinn update: I’m ready to converge on the common plan from my side. Strict meetings: m015 Job interview [0,1) full and m007 University class [13,14) full. Soft meetings on my schedule: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m012 [5,6), m009 [6,7), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13). I will skip m011, m006, m003, and m013. Note m012 [5,6) overlaps with m014 [4,6), so if we are strictly avoiding any self-overlap then I can instead skip m012 and keep the Jordan/Avery chain; otherwise I slightly prefer keeping m012 for extra overlap with Riley/Reese/Taylor. Please flag if anyone thinks the zero-overlap version is better; absent objections I’ll favor the zero-overlap chain.

Avery final planning note: I recommend we prioritize zero self-overlap, so Quinn/Taylor should skip any optional overlap that conflicts (e.g. m012 vs m014). From my side I’m locking: strict m015 [0,1) and m007 [13,14); soft m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m009 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13); skip m011 and m003. This seems well-coordinated with Jordan/Riley/Reese/Quinn/Taylor where possible.

Reese final planning note: I’m aligned with the emerging zero-self-overlap plan and intend to commit the following in execution unless something changes: strict m015 [0,1) full, skip m005; soft m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m012 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13); skip m011, m003, and m013. This matches the common chain and uses m012 at [7,8) since I’m not in m009. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley final planning confirmation: I’m aligned with the zero-self-overlap common plan and expect to commit in execution: strict m015 [0,1) full, skip m005, and m007 [13,14) full. Soft: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m012 [5,6), m006 [6,7), m009 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10); skip m011 and m003. This keeps my schedule conflict-free and overlaps with the shared chain where possible.

Taylor final planning confirmation: I’m aligned with the zero-self-overlap common plan from my side. I will likely commit strict m005 Doctor’s appointment [0,1) full and m007 University class [13,14) full. Soft: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m009 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13); skip m011, m012, m003, and m013. This keeps my schedule conflict-free and matches Avery/Riley/Jordan/Reese/Quinn on the main chain where possible; at [7,8) I’m choosing m009 to align with Avery/Riley.

Quinn final planning confirmation: I’m aligned with the zero-self-overlap common plan and expect to commit in execution: strict m015 Job interview [0,1) full and m007 University class [13,14) full. Soft on my meetings: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m009 [6,7), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13). I will skip m011, m012, m006, m003, and m013. This keeps my schedule conflict-free and matches the shared chain on the main meetings.

Reese confirmation: no changes from my final note. I’m planning to execute strict m015 [0,1) and skip m005. Soft: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m014 [4,6), m006 [6,7), m012 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10), m008 [10,13); skip m011, m003, m013. This remains zero-self-overlap and aligned with the shared chain.

Riley planning closeout: no changes from my final note. I’m set to execute m015 [0,1) full, skip m005, and m007 [13,14) full. Soft meetings on my side: m010 [1,2), m001 [2,3), m002 [3,4), m012 [5,6), m006 [6,7), m009 [7,8), m004 [8,9), m016 [9,10); skip m011 and m003. This stays zero-self-overlap and aligned with the shared chain.
